set -e
cd /opt/ai-relay
TMP=/tmp/keyo-home-compat
rm -rf "$TMP" && mkdir -p "$TMP"
echo "=== write index.html (4 parts) ==="
echo '' | sudo tee "$TMP/index.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/index.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/index.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo 'h1aijCb7lo//ti8FNLbPJ+/fnPxg+ZVBK/EJZwlMIipTy988t5Ke5ezONoBi+ZVBK/EFn+F/RYAbGi+wR7gZ7SAP4e7mZmIPdEOxeG4lPRXZSmPiPp5U5fPjtXjx8LTqvzHx1JvH1tTjhX7xUMe7sWuKB3wquwPm/478D6q5rg9MMgAA' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/index.html.b64" >/dev/null
base64 -d "$TMP/index.html.b64" | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/seo/index.html >/dev/null
wc -c /opt/ai-relay/static/seo/index.html
echo "=== write about.html (3 parts) ==="
echo '' | sudo tee "$TMP/about.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/about.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/about.html.b64" >/dev/null
base64 -d "$TMP/about.html.b64" | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/seo/about.html >/dev/null
wc -c /opt/ai-relay/static/seo/about.html
echo "=== write keyo-home.html (4 parts) ==="
echo '' | sudo tee "$TMP/keyo-home.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/keyo-home.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/keyo-home.html.b64" >/dev/null
echo '' | sudo tee -a "$TMP/keyo-home.html.b64" >/dev/null
base64 -d "$TMP/keyo-home.html.b64" | gunzip | sudo tee /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-home.html >/dev/null
wc -c /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-home.html
sudo docker cp /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-home.html ai-relay-new-api:/app/web/dist/brand/keyo-home.html 2>/dev/null || true
sudo docker cp /opt/ai-relay/static/brand/keyo-home.html ai-relay-new-api:/app/web/public/brand/keyo-home.html 2>/dev/null || true
curl -sS https://www.keyoapi.xyz/ | grep -o 'OpenAI-compatible on chat[^<]*' | head -n1 || true
curl -sS https://www.keyoapi.xyz/about | grep -o 'dedicated REST[^<]*' | head -n1 || true
echo DONE_HOME_COMPAT_INLINE
